steps.title: Implement NOAA Tide Height Fetcher
steps.instruction: Develop a utility function to fetch, parse, and cache hourly tide height predictions from the NOAA CO-OPS API for designated surf spot coordinates.
steps.acceptance: The utility must return structured JSON containing timestamped tide heights in meters, handle network timeouts gracefully, and pass the mock service tests.
steps.result: Completed the implementation of the tide fetcher utility in the services directory. Integrated the NOAA CO-OPS REST API with a 10-minute memory cache to prevent rate-limiting. All test cases passed on the first attempt without issues.
